info.title: Japan Address API
info.description: Normalize, geocode, and parse Japanese addresses. x402-enabled for AI agents.

post.summary: Convert a raw Japanese address into structured components
post.description: Normalize a Japanese (JP) address into clean prefecture / city / town / chome-banchi components. Fixes fullwidth/halfwidth digits, old-form kanji, and chome-banchi notation variants, and resolves the 7-digit postal code. Returns a 0-1 confidence score so agents can flag low-quality input. Use to deduplicate, validate, or canonicalize addresses before storage or comparison.

402.description: Payment required (x402). Payment requirements are in the base64-encoded Payment-Required response header.

address.description: A raw Japanese address string in any common format

example.address: 東京都千代田区永田町１ー７ー１

post.summary: Get lat/lng coordinates for a Japanese address
post.description: Geocode a Japanese (JP) address to WGS84 lat/lng coordinates, with a granularity level (prefecture → city → town → chome → banchi) and a 0-1 confidence score showing how precisely the input resolved. Japan-only. Use for mapping, distance calculation, or delivery routing.

402.description: Payment required (x402). Payment requirements are in the base64-encoded Payment-Required response header.

example.address: 東京都千代田区永田町1-7-1

post.summary: Get the Japanese address for lat/lng coordinates
post.description: Reverse-geocode WGS84 lat/lng coordinates within Japan to a normalized Japanese (JP) address with structured components. Use to label a GPS fix, a map pin, or a photo location with a human-readable address.

402.description: Payment required (x402). Payment requirements are in the base64-encoded Payment-Required response header.

get.summary: Look up address candidates for a 7-digit JP postal code
get.description: Look up Japanese (JP) address candidates for a 7-digit postal code (郵便番号), backed by the official Japan Post KEN_ALL dataset. One postal code can map to several towns; all candidates are returned with kana readings. Use for address autofill and postal-code validation.

402.description: Payment required (x402). Payment requirements are in the base64-encoded Payment-Required response header.

post.summary: Extract a structured address from messy Japanese text
post.description: Extract a fully structured Japanese (JP) address — prefecture, city, town, chome-banchi, plus building name, room number and addressee — from free-form, OCR, or voice-transcribed text. Use to turn one messy line into typed fields for invoices, shipping labels, or CRM records.

402.description: Payment required (x402). Payment requirements are in the base64-encoded Payment-Required response header.

text.description: Free-form text (OCR / voice transcript) containing a Japanese address

example.text: 東京都千代田区永田町1丁目7-1 衆議院第二議員会館 1234号室 田中太郎 様

post.summary: Convert up to 100 Japanese addresses in one batched call
post.description: Batch-normalize or batch-geocode up to 100 Japanese (JP) addresses in a single call — same processing as POST /normalize and POST /geocode, with per-item success/error reporting. Dynamic pricing: a small per-item fee. Use for bulk-cleaning an address column or import file.

items.description: Addresses to process; each item = {id, address} (max 100 items)
